text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wielding her experience as a weapon, Ikuno 
Dictus claimed victory. Through diligent 
maintenance and careful management, she 
safely overcame the grueling racing 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her strength, her self-management, and the 
fact that she finished the race safely 
once again—with deep respect for all of 
this, the crowd showered her with 
applause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Tokai Teio visits the 
waiting room. Now that her return to 
racing is in sight, she says she wants to 
run against Ikuno Dictus in the Arima 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus, who has run tirelessly to 
get this far. She wants to challenge the 
wealth of experience she has accumulated—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus readily accepted the 
invitation. With Nice Nature and 
Matikanetannhauser also confirmed to run, 
dreams gather at the Arima Kinen.
